_about: Which councils the plan brief is served for, and which clauses it skips. Read by app/api/brief/for-property/route.ts via lib/plan-brief.ts (inBriefScope, dropExcluded). Generated 2026-11-09 by a script that reads the section headings in each council's own PDF above every one of the top-5 clauses for a dwelling house in zone R2 (flagged = under a heading for another building type, a named place or estate, or an ancillary structure; garages are not flagged for car parking). A council is listed only if it keeps at least one unflagged clause for every topic and its top-5 recall on the proven rules after the skip is at least 80%.
limits: Keyword-based: it can miss a wrong-type heading and can flag a right one. Only house projects in zone R2 are covered; every other project type and zone shows no brief. Headings for ku_ring_gai are weakly classified (page footers).
